question: Which celebrity couple just quietly ended things?
story: One of comedy's most famous married couples just quietly split after eighteen years. If you listen to podcasts, you know Tom Segura and Christina P. They host Your Mom's House together, and they built an entire podcast empire as a team. TMZ reported on July thirteenth that the two have separated, and sources say it happened within the last couple of months. Here is the part that surprised everyone. According to those reports, the split is completely amicable. They got married back in 2008, they have two young sons, and they co-founded their whole company together. So even though the marriage is reportedly over, they are apparently still business partners running the same shows side by side. Fans are stunned, mostly because these two joked about their marriage on air for years. Sometimes the loudest couples fall apart the quietest.
